brand_identity.concept: A mystical-modern memorial and grief honoring web application designed to help people process loss with warmth, beauty, and celestial elegance. It transforms grief into a living archive of love.
brand_identity.aesthetic_archetype: Mystical Celestial Modernist (Deep Navy + Sculpted Gold + Electric Sky Blue + Warm Cream Paper)
brand_identity.tone: Warm, uplifting, mystical, highly aesthetic, intuitive, and deeply emotive (never depressing, cold, or clinical).

color_system.theme: Dark Celestial Navy base with glowing gold and bright sky blue highlights

tailwind_mappings.gold_btn: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#d4af37] via-[#f59e0b] to-[#d4af37] text-[#0b1a2f] font-semibold hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.6)] transition-all duration-300

usage_rules.titles_and_headers: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, H3 headings, Oracle Card titles, and Memory Book titles. Add tracking-wide for elegant display.
usage_rules.handwritten_letters: Use Caveat strictly for the handwritten body text in Cartas (Letters) and Memory Book personal notes (font-size 22px to 28px for realistic ink feel).
usage_rules.ui_controls_and_captions: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for navigation, form labels, buttons, tooltips, subtext, and operational status.

iconography_and_decorations.strict_rule: NO emojis allowed anywhere in the UI. Use only gold SVG icons (Lucide-react with text-[#d4af37] or custom celestial SVG paths).

action_icons.edit_pencil: Gold SVG Pencil icon (<Edit3 className='w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37] hover:text-[#fef08a]' />) - trigger for editable fields
action_icons.delete_trash: Gold/Amber SVG Trash icon (<Trash2 className='w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]/70 hover:text-red-400' />) - trigger with confirmation modal
action_icons.add_plus: <Plus className='w-5 h-5 text-[#d4af37]' /> with gold glowing circle frame
action_icons.download_pdf: <Printer /> or <FileDown className='w-4 h-4 text-[#d4af37]' /> for A4 PDF export

iconography_and_decorations.decorations: Celestial gold stars, thin geometric line-art borders, glowing stardust particles on click/hover.

brand_footer.position: Fixed sticky bottom navigation footer (z-index 50) that is never obscured by modals or scrollable content.
brand_footer.logo_spec: Thin geometric line-art gold cat sitting next to an oracle card deck / open book. Include brand text 'La Gata y la Magia' in Cormorant Garamond with small caption 'Mensajes Ancestrales'.
brand_footer.memory_book_stamp: The geometric gold cat logo is also rendered as a foil stamp seal on the last page of the Memory Book (Libro de Recuerdos).

home_avatar_selection.concept: Sanctuary grid where users can create multiple avatar cards (people or pets who passed away).
home_avatar_selection.avatar_card_design: Circular or arched photo container with 2px gold glowing border, editable photo frame with gold pencil overlay, avatar name in Cormorant Garamond, birth/passing dates, and entry action button.
home_avatar_selection.interactions: Edit photo modal with scale/crop controls, edit details modal, delete confirmation dialog.

avatar_dashboard.concept: A celestial hub connecting 5 sacred spaces for the selected avatar.
avatar_dashboard.grid_layout: Tetris-style asymmetrical bento layout with 5 distinct space portals:
portals: 3. Galería de Fotos (Photo Gallery with Categorized Folders)
5. Libro de Recuerdos (Flipbook Memory Book with Depth)

oraculo_deck.concept: Personal oracle card deck (up to 21 cards). Each card has a message, image/symbol, and title.
oraculo_deck.interactions: Interactive 3-second card shuffle animation with stardust glow, 3D card flip action, card reader modal, add/edit card dialog, PDF card deck export layout.

sinuous_timeline.concept: Vertical curved undulating SVG path with node markers representing memorable dates and moments.
sinuous_timeline.visuals: Alternating left/right cards along a glowing gold wavy line. Each milestone has an editable date, icon, title, description, and attached photo.

photo_gallery.concept: Grid of memories with custom folders (e.g., 'Viajes', 'Sonrisas', 'Momentos Especiales').
photo_gallery.visuals: Masonry or bento photo cards with gold frame hover, lightboxes, photo upload, folder management.

handwritten_letters.concept: Epistolary space for writing letters to the loved one.
handwritten_letters.letter_structure: Cream/Ivory stationery sheet background (#fdfbf7). Top right date, center avatar name greeting, main body text formatted in Caveat cursive font, bottom author signature.
handwritten_letters.actions: Edit letter, download letter as printable A4 PDF with brand ornate gold frame.

memory_book.concept: Digital hardbound memory album with realistic page-flip transitions and dimensional page shadows.
memory_book.structure: Cover page with avatar photo & gold embossed title, inner pages with photos and notes, final page with 'La Gata y la Magia' golden wax seal stamp.

pdf_export_and_backup.pdf_export: Generate printable A4 PDFs with gold border frames and 'La Gata y la Magia' watermark for Oracle Cards, Letters, Timeline, and Memory Book.
pdf_export_and_backup.json_backup: One-click Backup (Export JSON data) and Restore (Import JSON file) to ensure user memories are permanently preserved locally.

micro_interactions.glow_on_touch: All interactive gold buttons, cards, and icons feature a dynamic gold aura radial glow on hover and active touch.
micro_interactions.sparkle_effect: Subtle gold stardust sparkle particle trigger on button click and oracle card flip.
micro_interactions.modal_transitions: Framer motion scale-up + backdrop fade-in (0.25s ease-out).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure font links for Cormorant Garamond, Caveat, and Plus Jakarta Sans are added to index.html or imported in index.css.
Implement client-heavy local state with localStorage persistence and full JSON Export/Import capabilities.
Make all editable elements accessible via a gold pencil button, launching standard modal editors.
Adhere to strict data-testid attributes on all key buttons, inputs, modals, and navigation links.
Use glassmorphism for all dialogs, dropdowns, and cards over the deep navy background.
Keep the footer fixed at the bottom with high z-index and the gold cat logo.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards, modals) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='create-avatar-button', data-testid='edit-avatar-pencil', data-testid='oraculo-portal-card').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emojis: Never use emoji characters. Use Lucide React icons with text-[#d4af37] for celestial and gold icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsive_and_accessible: Ensure full responsiveness on mobile, tablet, and desktop with accessible contrast across all glassmorphic components.
